$comment: TEST FIXTURE - deliberately invalid. Extends the PQC migration profile, which accepts implemented, configured and observed, and tries to accept 'intended' as well. Widening the accepted lifecycle stages is a relaxation: a document reporting only intentions would conform to this profile while failing the base, which is what monotonic extension exists to prevent. The validator must reject it with exit code 3 rather than evaluating any CBOM against it, and check_profile must fail C7. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Invalid stage-widening profile (test fixture)

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the validator rejects a widened lifecycle-stage set.
